description: Coins locked to a SHRINCS post-quantum public key (a hash-based signature scheme), spendable only with a SHRINCS signature by that key over the spending transaction. The signature is made outside the wallet, by contrib/shrincs-signer, so a spend takes two runs: one prints the sighash, the other carries the signature.

shrincs_key.description: Coins spendable only with a SHRINCS signature by PK over the spending transaction's sig_all_hash.

PK.description: SHRINCS public key, PK.seed || PK.root, as `shrincs-signer pubkey` prints it.

Lock.description: Send coins to a SHRINCS public key.
Lock.intent: Lock {params.amount_sat} sat to a SHRINCS post-quantum key

PK.description: SHRINCS public key to lock to, from `shrincs-signer pubkey`.

ui.label: coins locked to the SHRINCS key

Spend.description: Spend a SHRINCS-locked coin with a signature made outside the wallet.
Spend.$comment: Run twice with the same state file and params. First with --print-sighash and placeholder SIG / OTHER_ROOT: it prints the sighash and stops. Then with the values `shrincs-signer sign` prints for that sighash. The destination is a fixed address and the fee comes from a fixed fee_rate, so the second run builds the same transaction and the signature verifies.

PK.description: The SHRINCS public key the coin is locked to.

SIG.description: The SHRINCS signature, as `shrincs-signer sign` prints it. Any placeholder for the --print-sighash run.

OTHER_ROOT.description: The stateless half's root, as `shrincs-signer sign` prints it. Any placeholder for the --print-sighash run.
